sounds.event: player holds interact at an oil barrel and picks up oil
sounds.prompt: short soft liquid slosh with a small wooden thunk, 0.4 seconds, cozy and warm, no splash spray, no reverb tail, no metallic clang

sounds.event: player pours oil into a lamp (held interact at the lamp)
sounds.prompt: gentle thick oil pouring into a glass lamp, 1.0 second, warm and soothing, a soft glug at the end, no water rushing, no harsh highs

sounds.event: the first lamp lights and the beam sweeps on (by second 10)
sounds.prompt: warm magical lamp igniting, soft whoosh then a glowing rising tone, 1.2 seconds, hopeful and cozy, no explosion, no fire roar, no horror

sounds.event: a lamp beam is on (quiet bed under the night)
sounds.prompt: very quiet seamless looping warm lantern hum, 4 seconds, low soft tone with faint shimmer, no pulsing, no beeps, no clicks at the loop point

sounds.event: player drags or swings a beam to a new aim
sounds.prompt: soft airy sweep with a light glassy shimmer, 0.5 seconds, smooth, no whoosh impact, no sci-fi laser, no harsh highs

sounds.event: a lane glows on the water 3 s before a creature spawns
sounds.prompt: gentle rising watery glow tone, 0.8 seconds, calm and clear like a soft bell under water, not alarming, no siren, no beep

sounds.event: a Mumble fog blob drifts in
sounds.prompt: soft round fog blob arriving, low squishy hum with a sleepy puff, 0.7 seconds, cute and gentle, no growl, no scary tone

sounds.event: beam is held on a creature (the 1.5 s pop timer)
sounds.prompt: rising sparkly build-up tone, 1.5 seconds, bright and anticipatory, pitch climbs steadily, no vocals, no harsh buzz

sounds.event: a Mumble pops into glow-sparkles under the beam
sounds.prompt: cute round little giggle with a soft sparkle pop, 0.6 seconds, friendly and bubbly, not a human voice, no scream, no gore squelch

sounds.event: a Flicker pops
sounds.prompt: tiny quick high sparkle pop with a squeaky twinkle, 0.4 seconds, light and zippy, no screech, no glass shatter

sounds.event: a Hushhog pops after two beams hold on it (co-op payoff)
sounds.prompt: big sleepy yawn-like soft pop that bursts into a warm sparkle bloom, 1.2 seconds, satisfying and cozy, no roar, no explosion

sounds.event: a Hushhog drifts in on its lane
sounds.prompt: slow low sleepy snuffle, one breath, 1.0 second, large and gentle, comedic, no growl, no menace

sounds.event: two stations' beams are on the same Hushhog
sounds.prompt: two soft tones snapping into a harmony chord, 0.6 seconds, warm and rewarding, teamwork feel, no buzzer, no click

sounds.event: a creature touches a lamp and dims it
sounds.prompt: soft flutter of a flame dimming with a small sad puff, 0.6 seconds, mild and not scary, no crash, no thunder

sounds.event: a lamp oil gauge drops low
sounds.prompt: two gentle soft wooden knocks, 0.5 seconds, a polite nudge, not an alarm, no beep, no siren

sounds.event: a lamp runs out of oil and goes dark
sounds.prompt: soft candle-snuff fade with a low gentle sigh of air, 0.8 seconds, mild, no dramatic fail sting, no horror

sounds.event: player holds interact at a dark lamp during the 2 s relight
sounds.prompt: soft rising flint-and-ember crackle that warms up over 2 seconds, gentle and encouraging, ends on a small glow, no loud spark, no fire roar, no beep

sounds.event: a lamp is relit (2 s relight completes)
sounds.prompt: quick warm flame catching with a bright little rising chime, 0.8 seconds, encouraging, no explosion

sounds.event: Glow (soft currency) is awarded, e.g. +5 on first pop
sounds.prompt: short bright glassy sparkle tick, 0.3 seconds, cheerful, no reverb tail, no coin-clink copy of any known game

sounds.event: a wave is cleared
sounds.prompt: warm two-note bell chime rising, 1.0 second, calm and satisfying, soft decay, no fanfare, no brass

sounds.event: rest beat starts and oil barrels refill
sounds.prompt: relaxed soft wooden barrel thumps with a gentle liquid fill and a calm breath of air, 1.2 seconds, restful, no alarms

sounds.event: player presses Start Night and the night begins
sounds.prompt: soft lighthouse bell toll with a gentle wind swell, 1.5 seconds, calm anticipation, deep blue night mood, no horror drone

sounds.event: mid-night fog event at 4:30 begins
sounds.prompt: soft low wind swell with a mysterious muted chime, 1.5 seconds, curious not scary, no thunder, no horror stinger

sounds.event: Thick Fog variant starts
sounds.prompt: heavy muffled air settling, soft low whoosh with a damp cotton feel, 1.2 seconds, no rumble, no scary tone

sounds.event: Gust variant starts
sounds.prompt: playful breezy gust with light whistling, 1.2 seconds, airy, no storm howl, no thunder

sounds.event: Lantern Rain variant starts (free oil drops)
sounds.prompt: gentle shower of tiny glowing glass chimes, 1.5 seconds, gift-like and magical, soft sparkle, no real rain noise

sounds.event: a player pings a lane with the on-screen marker
sounds.prompt: short soft sonar-like blip with a wooden tone, 0.3 seconds, clear but friendly, no beep-boop, no harsh highs

sounds.event: a player steps up to a station and a bot hands it back
sounds.prompt: quick friendly pat-and-swoosh, 0.4 seconds, light and cheerful, no voice, no clunk

sounds.event: dawn arrives and the sun rises with a celebration
sounds.prompt: warm sunrise swell with bells and soft strings-like pad, a hopeful lift ending in a gentle sparkle burst, 4 seconds, joyful and cozy, no copyrighted melody, no loud brass

sounds.event: a star is awarded on the result screen (1 to 3, one sound per star)
sounds.prompt: single bright bell ping with a small sparkle tail, 0.6 seconds, bright and rewarding, no reverb wash

sounds.event: result screen pays out Glow
sounds.prompt: quick cascading run of small glassy sparkle ticks, 1.0 second, cheerful and counting-up feel, no coin jackpot, no slot machine sound

sounds.event: a Lighthouse Board upgrade is funded (Lamp Polish, Longer Wick, Wide Lens, Sea Chime)
sounds.prompt: warm rising two-step chime with a soft metallic polish shimmer, 1.2 seconds, accomplished and proud, no fanfare, no brass

sounds.event: the Sea Chime cosmetic upgrade plays at the lighthouse
sounds.prompt: soft wind-chime tune of 4 gentle notes over distant waves, 3 seconds, peaceful, no copyrighted melody

sounds.event: first night of the day pays the +10 Glow daily bonus
sounds.prompt: bright cheerful morning-bell sparkle, 0.9 seconds, welcoming, no fanfare, no coin jackpot

sounds.event: 7 nights finished in the week; lamp color cosmetic granted
sounds.prompt: magical colorful shimmer sweep ending in a warm bell, 1.5 seconds, special and celebratory, no loud brass

sounds.event: any menu or button tap (Start Night, lobby buttons)
sounds.prompt: very short soft wooden tap with a tiny glassy tick, 0.1 seconds, subtle, no click-beep, no reverb

sounds.event: player closes a menu or cancels
sounds.prompt: very short soft low wooden tap, 0.1 seconds, subtle, slightly lower than a confirm tap, no beep

sounds.event: tutorial arrow appears ('Fuel the lamp', 'Light it up')
sounds.prompt: single gentle soft bell blink, 0.4 seconds, inviting, not a notification beep, no harsh highs

sounds.event: a Flicker appears on its lane
sounds.prompt: tiny quick zigzag twinkle with a squeaky blip, 0.4 seconds, playful and zippy, no screech, no buzz, no growl

sounds.event: a lamp visibly brightens after the first creature pops (first reward moment, 10-30 s)
sounds.prompt: soft warm glow swell with a gentle shimmer, 0.8 seconds, cozy and rewarding, no whoosh impact, no explosion

sounds.event: dawn arrives after a rough night (1 star, lamps out over 40% of the time)
sounds.prompt: gentle sleepy sunrise sigh with one soft bell, 2 seconds, kind and encouraging, try-again feeling, no sad trombone, no fail sting, no horror
